Asha (CS): Escalating: Enterprise customer 'VectorAI' can't apply sales-issued credit. They submitted PO #PO-88421. Promo code attempt returns 'invalid_promo_or_expired' and billing API shows 'insufficient_balance' despite credit on contract. Need manual adjustment.
Liam (Sales): Adding context: Contract 2025-E-712, committed credits 50k USD, sales promo code 'VECTOR-ENT-50K' included in SOW. Customer tried to paste code in Billing -> Credits UI, got error. They need immediate runway.
Rosa (Finance): Can you confirm the exact org id and invoice/PO number? We need PO and signed SOW to attach. Also who is the billing contact? cc @Liam (Sales)
Liam (Sales): Org: org_vek_999, Billing contact: karen@vectorai.com. PO PDF attached here: https://redwood.s3/pos/PO-88421.pdf (customer shared link).
Asha (CS): Repro steps from customer: 1) Console -> Billing -> Apply promo 2) Paste code -> Submit 3) UI shows toast 'applied' but balance unchanged, api returns 400 on /v1/credits/apply with body: {"error":"invalid_promo_or_expired"}. I also hit the API myself: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/credits/apply -d '{"org":"org_vek_999","code":"VECTOR-ENT-50K"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' -> 400
Evan (Eng): I'll take a look. Can you give me the request id from the failed API call? Or full response body from the customer? The 400 might be a validation mismatch between contract meta and promo metadata.
Asha (CS): Customer provided request_id: req_20250301_4b9f. Full response: {"error":"invalid_promo_or_expired","details":"promo not active for org"}. They quoted the exact code from SOW.
Evan (Eng): Thanks. I checked promo config: code VECTOR-ENT-50K is active but restricted to org whitelist that uses enterprise_id 'ent_712'. Their org is linked to ent_712? Looking at DB shows org_vek_999 is linked to ent_711 (close but different). That's why it's rejected.
Rosa (Finance): How did that mapping happen? If SOW lists ent_712, we need to correct customer's enterprise mapping. Liam, was the onboarding script executed with ent_711?
Liam (Sales): Onboarding ran last week; looks like a mismatch — internal provisioning used staging enterprise id. My bad. I'll re-run provisioning to link org_vek_999 -> ent_712. ETA 30 mins. Leaving a note to apply manual credit if provisioning takes longer.
Rosa (Finance): Finance can push a manual one-off credit of $50,000 as a temporary measure. Need to attach PO to the credit record and add note: 'Manual enterprise promo grant per SOW 2025-E-712, PO-88421'. Asha please confirm amount and approval.
Asha (CS): Customer asked for 50k USD credit. They approved temporary manual grant. Please proceed.
billing-bot: Automated action: Created credit txn id cr_txn_20250301_77a. Amount: 50000. Status: PENDING_APPROVAL.
Rosa (Finance): Approved. Marking txn cr_txn_20250301_77a as APPROVED. Attached PO-88421. Note added.
billing-bot: Transaction cr_txn_20250301_77a status -> APPROVED. Org balance updated: +50000 credits. Promo still restricted to ent_712; recommend re-provisioning so promo code works for future applies.
Evan (Eng): Once Liam re-provisions, I can whitelist org_vek_999 under ent_712 in promo config. Ping me when done.
Liam (Sales): Re-provision completed. org_vek_999 now linked to ent_712. I validated user mapping.
Evan (Eng): Done: I updated promo whitelist. Retested via curl -> 200 {"status":"applied","new_balance":50000}. Ask customer to try applying code again; should work but they already have manual credit.
Asha (CS): Customer confirmed: UI now accepts code and shows 'Code already redeemed' but balance unchanged (they have the manual credit). They're happy and asked for PO note in invoice. Rosa can you confirm PO note?
Rosa (Finance): Added PO note to invoice and to account: 'PO-88421: enterprise credit applied per SOW 2025-E-712'. Closing ticket after 24h confirmation. :white_check_mark:
